_note: This agent is triggered by an n8n Form Trigger with a file upload field ('dokument'). The two sections below are both from real test executions run on 2026-09-01 (n8n execution ids 271/272) — they were not fabricated. A genuine successful PDF/TXT analysis run could not be captured this way: the API-based test tool used to generate this documentation always uploads files as 'application/octet-stream' regardless of the real file extension, which does not match any of the workflow's exact MIME-type checks (application/pdf, text/plain, text/csv, .xlsx). A real browser file upload sets the correct MIME type and does not hit this issue — see 'known_gaps' in technical-summary.md.

illustrative_successful_analysis_output_.description: NOT captured from a real execution (see note above) — this illustrates the structure the 'textanalysis(PDF/TXT)' system prompt defines, for documentation purposes only. Do not treat the analysis content itself as real.
